newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent futures, NYMEX, stage late recovery.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent futures, NYMEX, stage late recovery.

text.p: IPE Brent futures staged a late recovery in the final half-hour of business on Friday to conclude 15 cents down on the day, dealers said.

August Brent futures hit a low of $17.48 at one point in an afternoon slump as the New York crude and gasoline market and technical factors pushed values lower. But the late surge brought numbers back up to $17.63 a barrel.

In New York the expiring July WTI contract also showed some late strength. It last traded at $18.65, two cents down on the day but well above the day's trough of $18.35 as buyers returned to the market.
"We ended up settling on the higher notes of the day just on the fact the Brent failed dramatically to get through the $17.45-$17.50 level," said one broker.
After a stagnant morning at the IPE business picked up when New York opened and downward momentum built after the August contract fell below $17.68, its low over the previous two days.
Further support at $17.61 was breached and numbers fell towards their next target, the 13-month low of $17.38 on the spot chart.
A thin market, indecision ahead of next week's OPEC meet and the Iraq conundrum lent the support to kick values back up.
"It was quite quiet on the news front but with OPEC coming up no-one wanted to take a big position on a Friday night ahead of that kind of meeting," said one dealer.
Most market participants believe the 11-nation cartel will "roll-over" the current supply quotas and do little to halt the over-production that has undermined world oil prices.
Although continued worry over when Iraq would resume crude exports was not as supportive as on Thursday, it was still in people's minds.
Baghdad has said it will not resume crude exports until $800 million already earned can be spend on humanitarian supplies.
Earlier IPE gas oil finished at $158.50 a tonne, $1 lower on the day.
"There was a bit of trade selling at the end which kept it under pressure but otherwise it was quiet, no fireworks," said one player.
